annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: 2000–2003: about every 3,000–7,500 miles. 2020 and newer: when the oil change indicator says, up to about 10,000 miles
maint.note: The 2020+ 3.6L V6 uses full synthetic 0W-20; the older engines use 5W-30.
A heavy minivan wears front brakes quickly.
Many 2000–2003 vans have rear drum brakes; 2020 and newer use rear discs.
2020 and newer vans with stop/start also have a small auxiliary battery.

maint.every: About every 30,000–100,000 miles depending on engine; check the owner's manual
maint.note: Rear plugs on the V6 engines take longer to reach.

maint.every: About every 5 years (older vans) to 10 years/150,000 miles (2020 and newer)
